claim: If you don't put a barcode on your KDP paperback cover, Amazon places one on the back cover for you, so leave its space clear: KDP's own downloadable cover templates reserve a 2 x 1.2 inch box in the lower right of the back cover, 0.25 inch in from the trim. The free Puzzle Press spine calculator draws that box on a 300 DPI cover template sized to your book.
notes: Real-time capture of the live spine calculator at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels, 6x9, 120 pages, white paper. It opens on the Barcode line ('Leave 2" x 1.2" clear in the lower right of the back cover'), taps Download this cover template, then shows the downloaded 3756 x 2775 px PNG itself: the whole back cover, then a 3.2 s zoom into the barcode box. KDP help G201953020 (re-read 2026-11-09): 'You can upload a cover with or without a barcode. If you choose not to provide your own barcode, we'll automatically place one on your back cover.' That page gives no size; the 2 x 1.2 inch box and 0.25 inch margin are the clear area in KDP's downloadable cover templates. The zoom is a CSS transform of the PNG, nothing drawn on it. The grey ring marks the tap. The final 2.2 s hold still for the end card.
